_comment: Human-maintained ex-dividend calendar for the exdiv-lighter book instance (bot-strategy#948). One row per (symbol, ex_date). Only status=declared rows reach the runtime calendar and the producer; keep status=estimated until the issuer has declared the date and amount, then update from the source. Symbols are Lighter perp names; hedge is US500 (S&P 500 ETFs) / US100 (QQQ) or null for unhedged single stocks. Regenerate the runtime calendar after every edit: scripts/exdiv_signal_producer.py calendar --events configs/book/exdiv-events.json --out configs/book/exdiv-lighter.calendar.json (CI checks the two agree).

events.source: annual December distribution, date and amount not yet declared (bot-strategy#948)
